title: TesseraQL test suite (tests/*.yml)
$comment: Deliberately open (additionalProperties: true): newer keys never break older editors. Each case sets exactly one target - sql, contract, validate, notify, messages, http-call, or decide - stated as prose rather than a oneOf so editors report missing keys, not opaque union failures.

file.description: The 2-way SQL file under the app home this case executes.

contract.description: A named identity contract to execute instead of a SQL file.

principal.description: The request principal the case runs as (docs data-scoping): resolves /*%scope ... */ directives in the target SQL through the app's scope/ declarations exactly as the runtime would, and seeds the principal.* ambient paths. Without it, a scoped statement renders deny-by-default for arms that need a principal.

validate.description: Exercises one declarative validation rule of a route.

decide.description: Evaluates one decision declared under decisions/ against the params as input values (docs decision-tables). Outputs come back as the case's single row; a miss or unique multi-hit comes back as one row carrying code (TQL-DECISION-4721/4720). effectiveAt dates a table-source lookup (ISO-8601 or yyyy-MM-dd HH:mm:ss).

transition.description: Fires one declared workflow transition against the document named by key, inside the case's rolled-back transaction, through the documented pipeline (state legality, decide, guard, conditional advance, scoped command, zero-row contract). The outcome is the case's single row: from/to on an advance, or a code row (TQL-WORKFLOW-3201/3202/3204, TQL-DECISION-4720/4721) so a refusal is assertable as data. Pair with principal for scoped commands.

expect.description: Data-independent expectations over the case's result.

verify.description: Follow-up SQL checks after a sql-target case, each with its own params and expect.
